provenance: Second independently authored synthetic engineering exercise, frozen after an initial evaluation found negation bugs but before the corrected v3 model was published. Different vacancy stacks and story texts. No professional HR adjudication or real candidates.
label_policy: Labels encode available screening evidence only: 3 established complete work,2 relevant work with incomplete requirement evidence,1 relevant junior work below explicit tenure,0 insufficient professional evidence. They are not hiring probabilities or statements of actual human ability.
usage: Evaluation only. Do not train or select model parameters using these labels or scores. Author knew the initial bug class; this is a bounded engineering check, not an unbiased clinical or population study.
metrics: Macro vacancy-query NDCG@5 with linear gains and tied-order expectation; macro comparable-pair accuracy; strict predeclared preferences with ties credited one half.
